title: Anthropic native chat provider
objective: Add a non-OpenAI native chat provider path while preserving ProviderRegistry and RuntimeConfig boundaries.

steps.description: Study AstrBot ProviderAnthropic payload mapping, system prompt handling, and response parsing.
Implement AnthropicConfig and AnthropicProvider behind the ChatProvider trait.
Register anthropic_chat_completion in ProviderRegistry and expose runtime config construction.
Add integration tests for text/system/context, data URL image content, error mapping, and runtime config mapping.
Run formatting, workspace tests, clippy, and CLI smoke verification.
